# runpod_endpoint_workers (Data Source)

Workers currently allocated to a Serverless endpoint, with the per-status counts the console shows. Worker allocation changes with load, so every plan shows this data source as needing a refresh.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_endpoint_workers" "vllm" {
  endpoint_id = "ep_abc123"
}

output "running_workers" {
  description = "How many workers are handling requests."
  value       = data.runpod_endpoint_workers.vllm.summary.running
}

output "stale_worker_ids" {
  description = "Workers still running an older configuration version."
  value       = [for w in data.runpod_endpoint_workers.vllm.workers : w.id if w.is_stale]
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
use-case modules under `v2/modules/` in the provider repository; the Guides
section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint_id` (String) Serverless endpoint identifier.

### Read-Only

- `endpoint_version` (Number) The endpoint's current configuration version; compare against a worker's version to spot workers on an older release.
- `summary` (Attributes) Worker counts by status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--summary))
- `workers` (Attributes List) One entry per worker. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workers))

<a id="nestedatt--summary"></a>
### Nested Schema for `summary`

Read-Only:

- `idle` (Number) Workers ready but not handling a request.
- `initializing` (Number) Workers still starting up.
- `running` (Number) Workers handling a request.
- `throttled` (Number) Workers held back by capacity limits.
- `total` (Number) All workers allocated to the endpoint.
- `unhealthy` (Number) Workers the platform considers unhealthy.


<a id="nestedatt--workers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workers`

Read-Only:

- `data_center_id` (String) Data center the worker runs in.
- `gpu_count` (Number) Number of GPUs attached to the worker.
- `gpu_type_id` (String) GPU type the worker was placed on.
- `id` (String) Worker identifier; pass it to runpod_endpoint_worker_logs.
- `image` (String) Docker image the worker is running.
- `is_stale` (Boolean) Whether the worker runs an older configuration version than the endpoint's current one.
- `started_at` (String) Worker start timestamp in RFC 3339 format; null while it is still initializing.
- `status` (String) Worker status: IDLE, INITIALIZING, RUNNING, THROTTLED, or UNHEALTHY.
- `uptime_seconds` (Number) Seconds since the worker started.
- `version` (Number) Endpoint configuration version the worker is running.
